question: 500 MW 聚变功率连续运行一年消耗的氚质量:DT 反应每次消耗 1 个氚原子,反应率=P/(17.6 MeV)。求年消耗氚质量(kg)。常数:1 eV=1.602176634e-19 J,氚原子质量 m_T=3.016×1.6605390666e-27 kg,一年=365×86400 s。

metadata.source: DT 燃耗计算(公开物理常数)

question_en: Mass of tritium consumed by continuous operation at 500 MW fusion power for one year: Each DT reaction consumes 1 tritium atom, and the reaction rate = P/(17.6 MeV). Calculate the annual mass of tritium consumed (kg). Constants: 1 eV = 1.602176634e-19 J, tritium atomic mass m_T = 3.016 × 1.6605390666e-27 kg, one year = 365 × 86400 s.

question: 聚变堆第一壁/包层结构材料为什么普遍选用低活化铁素体/马氏体钢(RAF/M)而不是奥氏体不锈钢?

options.A: 14 MeV 中子辐照下 dpa 损伤更小且活化产物半衰期短、废热低,便于近距维护与核废料管理
options.B: 铁素体钢熔点更高,可以承受更高表面温度
options.D: 铁素体钢抗腐蚀性更好

metadata.source: 聚变材料学公开综述(RAF/M 钢 Eurofer-97 等,常见教材/综述内容)
metadata.notes: 低活化冶金 + 辐照肿胀各向异性小是主因

question_en: Why are reduced activation ferritic/martensitic steels (RAF/M) generally selected as the structural materials for the first wall/blanket of fusion reactors instead of austenitic stainless steels?

options_en.A: Under 14 MeV neutron irradiation, the dpa damage is lower, and the activation products have short half-lives and low waste heat, which facilitates close-range maintenance and nuclear waste management.
options_en.B: Ferritic steel has a higher melting point and can withstand higher surface temperatures.
options_en.C: Austenitic stainless steel is too expensive
options_en.D: Ferritic steel has better corrosion resistance.

question: 氚增殖比(TBR)估算:设每个 DT 中子进入包层后,Be(n,2n) 倍增使可用中子数×1.3,其中被 Li-6 俘获产氚的概率为 0.75(每次俘获产 1 个氚)。求 TBR,并判断该包层能否支持氚自持(TBR>1)。

metadata.source: TBR 定义与中子学估算方法(聚变中子学公开教科书/综述)
metadata.notes: 1.3×0.75=0.975<1,需提高 Li-6 富集度或增设倍增剂

question_en: Estimation of Tritium Breeding Ratio (TBR): Assume that after each DT neutron enters the blanket, the Be(n,2n) multiplication increases the number of available neutrons by a factor of 1.3, and of these available neutrons, the probability of tritium production via capture by Li-6 is 0.75 (one tritium is produced per capture). Calculate the TBR and determine whether this blanket can support tritium self-sufficiency (TBR>1).

question: ITER 级磁体储能密度估算:磁场能量密度 u=B²/(2μ0)。求 B=5.3 T 时的 u(J/m³)。常数:μ0=4π×1e-7 H/m。

metadata.source: 磁能密度公式(电磁学公开公式);ITER 场强为官方公开参数
metadata.notes: u≈11.2 MJ/m³,超导磁体总储能 GJ 量级

question_en: Estimation of energy storage density of ITER-class magnets: The magnetic field energy density is u=B²/(2μ0). Find u(J/m³) when B=5.3 T. Constant: μ0=4π×1e-7 H/m.
